title: Wikidata within its limits: one query at a time, its wait honoured, answers kept
why: Jason, 2026-11-20, approved (reviewed by the session manager). Wikidata's query service has answered 429 (too many requests) since Nov 18 (the board's issue #26), so place pages miss nearby places and labels. PlaceFinder and Dossier now ask it through app/lib/Wdqs.php: one query at a time across the site (others skip, never pile up), the wait Wikidata asks for (Retry-After) kept and honoured by every caller, and each answer kept 7 days. It changes how we ask, not what we read. No new tables.
